fact: As of 30 September 2026 eighteen Benin institutions (14 banks, Julaya, Moov Money, MTN and Pebco Bethesda) were authorised to open BCEAO's PI-SPI interoperable instant payment service to the public.
title: Liste des participants autorisés à ouvrir les services de PI-SPI au public (mise à jour du 30 septembre 2026)
